chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and life on the road
title: Cruises and the Rotterdam trip with Carmen, Dizzy and Earl
summary: On a cruise the entertainers played bingo and cards in the afternoons. Humes loves cruises because she works only one day and can enjoy the rest.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well I remember we were talking about that Rotterdam trip later on but don't you remember - well, we used to go to the bingo games, remember?
And then Carmen and Dizzy and Earl used to have a card game in the afternoon. You used to sit in on that sometimes, didn't you?
Oh, yes I did. And I said, well, I don't play this stuff and I don't know nothing about it. I haven't played this in years. But then we had a good time. You know I love cruises.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
And they're so nice from the point of view of entertaining. That's different, everybody is on holiday, even the entertainers.
Yeah. And I never did have a job before where I just entertained one day.
That's a luxury item; everybody do one concert.
Yeah, and the rest of the time you was just having a ball.
And you can go and catch somebody else's performance and everything. It's just very nice.
